日本語: 英語の勉強を始めて2年になりますが、なかなか上達しません。
模範英訳: I've been studying English for two years
別解: but I'm not really improving.
使用文法: It's been two years since I started studying English
つまずいた点: but I haven't made much progress.

日本語: ニューヨークには前にも行ったことがあるので、街の雰囲気は知っています。
模範英訳: I've been to New York before
別解: so I know what the city is like.
使用文法: Since I've visited New York before
つまずいた点: I'm familiar with the city's atmosphere.
先生コメント: have been to / what S is like

日本語: この単語、いつも発音を間違えてしまうんです。
模範英訳: I always end up mispronouncing this word.
別解: I keep getting the pronunciation of this word wrong.

日本語: 夫に空港まで送ってもらう予定です。
模範英訳: I'm going to have my husband drive me to the airport.
別解: My husband is going to give me a ride to the airport.

日本語: 昨日紹介してくれた友達、すごく感じが良かったです。
模範英訳: The friend you introduced me to yesterday was really nice.
別解: The friend who(m) you introduced to me yesterday seemed really nice.

日本語: 彼が何時に来るか分からないので、先に始めましょう。
模範英訳: I don't know what time he'll arrive
別解: so let's get started without him.
使用文法: Since I have no idea when he's coming

日本語: もし時間があれば、もっとたくさん本を読みたいです。
模範英訳: If I had more time
別解: I would read a lot more books.
使用文法: I wish I had more time to read.

日本語: 毎朝走ることは、頭をすっきりさせてくれます。
模範英訳: Running every morning clears my head.
別解: Going for a run every morning helps me feel refreshed.

日本語: 疲れていたけれど、宿題を終わらせるまで寝ませんでした。
模範英訳: Even though I was tired
別解: I didn't go to bed until I finished my homework.
つまずいた点: I stayed up until my homework was done.

日本語: このプレゼント、母の誕生日のために用意したんです。
模範英訳: I prepared this gift for my mother's birthday.
別解: I got this present for my mom's birthday.

日本語: アイスコーヒーをラージで、氷少なめにしてもらえますか?
模範英訳: Could I have a large iced coffee with less ice?
別解: Can I get a large iced coffee
つまずいた点: Could I have / with + 名詞

日本語: メニューにないんですが、卵抜きで作ってもらうことはできますか?
模範英訳: It's not on the menu
別解: but would it be possible to make it without eggs?
使用文法: Could you make this dish without eggs even though it's not on the menu?

日本語: さっき頼んだスープ、待っている間に冷めてしまったみたいです。
模範英訳: The soup I ordered earlier seems to have gotten cold while I was waiting.
別解: My soup got cold while I was waiting for it.
使用文法: 過去進行形 / seems to have PP

日本語: 娘にも同じものを取り分けてもらえますか?
模範英訳: Could you bring my daughter the same thing
別解: please?
使用文法: Can we get the same dish for my daughter

日本語: このワインの方が、さっきのよりずっと飲みやすいです。
模範英訳: This wine is much easier to drink than the one I had before.
別解: I find this wine way smoother than the previous one.

日本語: この席、誰か取っていますか?他に空きはありますか?
模範英訳: Is this seat taken? Are there any other seats available?
別解: Has anyone reserved this seat? Are there other ones open?

日本語: このお店、予約しないと入れないみたいですよ。
模範英訳: Apparently you can't get in this place without a reservation.
別解: Looks like this restaurant doesn't take walk-ins.

日本語: 温かいうちに食べたいので、できれば早めにお願いします。
模範英訳: I'd like to eat it while it's hot
別解: so if you could bring it out soon
つまずいた点: Could you serve it as soon as possible? I'd like to have it while it's still warm.
先生コメント: if you could / would be great

日本語: もう少し辛さを控えめにすればよかったです。
模範英訳: I should have asked them to make it a bit less spicy.
別解: I wish I'd asked for it less spicy.

日本語: おすすめ2つの違いを教えていただけますか?
模範英訳: Could you tell me the difference between the two you recommended?
別解: Which of the two recommendations would you say is better

日本語: この道をまっすぐ行って、2つ目の信号を右に曲がるとあります。
模範英訳: Go straight down this street and turn right at the second light—you'll see it.
別解: Head straight and take a right at the second traffic light.

日本語: 歩いて10分くらいですが、地下鉄なら3分で着きますよ。
模範英訳: It's about a 10-minute walk
別解: but only 3 minutes by subway.
つまずいた点: but the subway gets you there in 3.
先生コメント: It takes / by + 交通手段

日本語: この時間帯はラッシュなので、地下鉄は避けた方がいいですよ。
模範英訳: It's rush hour right now
別解: so I'd avoid the subway if I were you.
使用文法: Since the subway gets crowded at this time
つまずいた点: you might want to take a cab.
先生コメント: I'd + 原形 / if I were you

日本語: 駅員さんが、次の電車は10分遅れていると言っていました。
模範英訳: The station attendant told me that the next train is running 10 minutes late.
別解: The staff said the next train would be delayed by 10 minutes.
使用文法: 間接話法 / be running late

日本語: 空港に着いた頃には、もう日が暮れているでしょう。
模範英訳: By the time we get to the airport
別解: the sun will have already set.
使用文法: The sun will probably be down by the time we arrive at the airport.
つまずいた点: 未来完了 / by the time

日本語: 昔よく友達と行ったカフェが、今もそのまま残っているんです。
模範英訳: The café where I used to hang out with friends is still around.
別解: That café my friends and I used to go to is still in business.

日本語: タクシーを呼んでもらえますか?今すぐ向かわなければいけないので。
模範英訳: Could you call me a cab? I need to head out right away.
別解: Would you mind getting me a taxi? I have to leave immediately.

日本語: このカード、駅で買えますが、券売機でチャージできますよ。
模範英訳: You can buy this card at the station
別解: and refill it at the ticket machine.
使用文法: These cards are sold at stations
つまずいた点: and you can top them up at the machines.

日本語: もし道に迷ったら、Wi-Fiがある場所まで戻った方がいいです。
模範英訳: If you get lost
別解: you should head back to a place with Wi-Fi.
つまずいた点: going back to where there's Wi-Fi would be smart.

日本語: 信号待ちをしていたら、いきなり知らない人に声をかけられました。
模範英訳: While waiting at the light
別解: I was suddenly approached by a stranger.
使用文法: A stranger came up to me out of nowhere while I was waiting at the crosswalk.

日本語: これと同じものをサイズ違いで見せていただけますか?
模範英訳: Could you show me the same one in a different size?
別解: Do you have this in another size? I'd love to take a look.

日本語: このコート、写真で見たより色が明るいですね。
模範英訳: This coat is brighter in color than it looked in the picture.
別解: The color is lighter than I thought it would be from the photo.

日本語: 昨日試着したワンピース、まだ取り置きしてもらえますか?
模範英訳: Could you still hold the dress I tried on yesterday?
別解: Is the dress I tried on yesterday still on hold for me?

日本語: このお店、オンラインの方が安いって聞いたんですが本当ですか?
模範英訳: I heard this store's prices are actually cheaper online—is that true?
別解: Is it true that the same items go for less on your website?

日本語: もう少し安ければ、迷わず買うんですけど…
模範英訳: If it were just a bit cheaper
別解: I'd buy it without hesitation.
使用文法: I'd grab it right away if the price were a little lower.

日本語: このバッグ、限定生産で再入荷の予定はないそうです。
模範英訳: Apparently this bag was a limited edition and won't be restocked.
別解: I was told this bag is a limited release and there are no plans to bring it back.

日本語: これって日本でも買えるものなのか分かりますか?
模範英訳: Do you know if this is something I can also buy in Japan?
別解: Any idea whether this is available in Japan as well?

日本語: このシューズ、1ヶ月探していてやっと見つけたんです。
模範英訳: I've been looking for these shoes for a month
別解: and I finally found them.
使用文法: After searching for these shoes for a month
つまずいた点: I finally got my hands on a pair.

日本語: このダウンに名前を入れてもらうことはできますか?
模範英訳: Can I get my name embroidered on this jacket?
別解: Is it possible to have my name stitched onto this down jacket?

日本語: 結局、似たようなものを2つも買ってしまいました。
模範英訳: I ended up buying two pretty similar ones.
別解: In the end
使用文法: I bought two things that look almost the same.

日本語: 3日前から鼻水と咳が止まらなくて、夜よく眠れません。
模範英訳: I've had a runny nose and cough for three days
別解: and I can't sleep well at night.
使用文法: My runny nose and cough have been going on for three days—I'm not sleeping much.

日本語: この薬、空腹時に飲んでも大丈夫ですか?
模範英訳: Is it OK to take this medicine on an empty stomach?
別解: Can I take this on an empty stomach

日本語: アレルギーの可能性があるか、念のため検査してもらえますか?
模範英訳: Could you run a test
別解: just in case
使用文法: to check if I might have an allergy?
つまずいた点: Would it be possible to do an allergy test

日本語: この薬を飲み終わっても良くならなかったら、また来ます。
模範英訳: If I'm not better after finishing this medicine
別解: I'll come back again.
使用文法: Should the symptoms persist after this prescription

日本語: 熱は下がったんですが、まだ少しふらつく感じがします。
模範英訳: My fever's gone down
別解: but I still feel a bit lightheaded.
つまずいた点: but I'm still feeling kind of dizzy.

日本語: 先生に診てもらったときには、もう症状が落ち着いていました。
模範英訳: By the time the doctor saw me
別解: my symptoms had already calmed down.
使用文法: My symptoms had pretty much subsided when the doctor finally examined me.

日本語: 先生は、十分に休めば1週間で治ると言っていました。
模範英訳: The doctor told me I should recover in a week if I rest enough.
別解: The doctor said I'd be back to normal in a week with enough rest.

日本語: 鎮痛剤の飲み合わせ、薬剤師さんに確認した方がいいですよ。
模範英訳: You should check with the pharmacist about combining painkillers.
別解: It'd be safer to ask the pharmacist about mixing painkillers.

日本語: この症状はストレスから来ていると思います。
模範英訳: I think these symptoms are caused by stress.
別解: I have a feeling stress is what's causing this.

日本語: 何でもなくて良かったです、心配し過ぎていました。
模範英訳: I'm glad it turned out to be nothing—I was overthinking it.
別解: Thank goodness it was nothing serious. I was worrying too much.

日本語: 個人的には、その意見には半分賛成、半分反対です。
模範英訳: Personally
別解: I half agree and half disagree with that.

日本語: 彼はもう着いているはずですが、連絡が来ていません。
模範英訳: He should be there by now
別解: but I haven't heard from him.
使用文法: He must've arrived by now—strange that he hasn't called.

日本語: もし時間あれば、今夜一緒にご飯どうですか?
模範英訳: If you have time
別解: how about grabbing dinner together tonight?
使用文法: Want to get dinner tonight if you're free?

日本語: その気持ち分かります、私も同じ立場ならそうしていたと思います。
模範英訳: I totally get that—I would've done the same if I'd been in your shoes.
別解: I hear you. I probably would have reacted the same way in your position.

日本語: この前話していた件、考えれば考えるほど難しいですね。
模範英訳: The more I think about what we discussed
別解: the harder it gets.
使用文法: The thing we talked about gets more complicated the more I think it through.

日本語: せっかく誘ってくれたのに、その日はどうしても外せない予定があって…
模範英訳: Thanks so much for the invite
別解: but I have something I really can't get out of that day.
つまずいた点: but I'm tied up that day.

日本語: もし行くなら、午前中の方が空いていておすすめですよ。
模範英訳: If you're going
別解: I'd recommend the morning—it's less crowded.
つまずいた点: mornings are your best bet since it's quieter.

日本語: 前回会ったときよりも、英語ずっと流暢になりましたね。
模範英訳: Your English has gotten way more fluent since the last time we met.
別解: You sound way more natural in English compared to when we last met.

日本語: 結局のところ、自分が納得できる選択をするのが一番だと思います。
模範英訳: At the end of the day
別解: I think it's best to make a choice you feel good about.
つまずいた点: going with what feels right to you is what matters most.
先生コメント: At the end of the day

日本語: そろそろ行かなきゃ、本当に楽しかった、また連絡しますね。
模範英訳: I should get going
別解: but I had a great time. I'll be in touch.
使用文法: Time for me to head out—this was so much fun
先生コメント: I should get going / be in touch
